title: Context Menu Surface Styling
description: Explains context menu surface styling and z-index layering.
body: The surface the shell's right-click menu is drawn on. The rows inside it are MenuItemList's, so menuItemList.css already owns every pixel of them. The context menu is z-index 42, above submenu at 41, so a right-click while a title-bar submenu is open shows the newer menu in front.
